thread:
emma: Heads-up: sample-app JSON-mode + schema-helper failing intermittently when token refresh happens. parsing throws in consumer.
rafael: can you paste minimal repro?
emma: tiny TS snippet reproduces ~40% for me:
```ts
const r = await client.tool.call({ mode: 'json', input: { prompt: 'hello' } })
console.log('parsed', r.parsed)
```
kevin: saw this once — looks like auth retry ended up sending a double-encoded body, so the schema helper sees a string instead of object and bails.
nia: logs?
emma: excerpt:
[2026-03-20T11:05:02Z] prepare -> {"prompt":"hello"}
[2026-03-20T11:05:02Z] send -> "{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}"
[2026-03-20T11:05:03Z] 401 -> refresh -> retry sends -> '"{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}"'
Error: invalid JSON at position 0

kevin: double-encode triggered because retry path calls serialize unconditionally. Quick workaround: for json-mode, set client.options.retry = false or patch retry to detect already-stringified bodies.
rafael: for long-term: add guard in auth middleware: if typeof body === 'string' and looks like JSON (startsWith('{') or startsWith('\"{')) then skip stringify. Also add unit tests for JS+Py SDK parity, and an integration that forces a 401 on first attempt.
nia: can we also update the schema-helper to accept string payloads and attempt a parse before failing? defensive but reduces noisy onboard friction.
kevin: agree. small change in helper: if typeof v === 'string' try JSON.parse(v) then validate. I'll PR both fixes (auth middleware + helper fallback).
sdk-bot: created RW-2410: "json-mode double-encode on auth retry -> schema helper failures (JS+Py)" assigned to @kevin, labels: devex, p2
emma: thanks. I'll attach the mini sample-app (TS + Py) to the issue and add a note in onboarding doc to disable auto-retry for early experiments.
